children: Russian Central Bank estimates that the fuel crunch has contributed between 0.7 and 0.8 percentage points to inflation, Andrey Gangan, director of the monetary policy department, said on Tuesday.
Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy infrastructure have triggered fuel shortages in the country, disrupting supplies and pushing up prices.
